issues.quote: 那我們請他發電子郵件給我們吧。
issues.description: The Spanish line Entonces le voy a pedir que nos mande un correo says the current speaker will ask. The translation makes the asking action a collective 我們 proposal, while nos only establishes the recipients of the email. This fails the predeclared actor/translation consistency criterion. A team-oriented paraphrase is understandable, but the teaching translation should preserve the explicit singular agent.
